column5: What if you grew one centimeter every minute?
You stand in your living room.
You no longer fit through the door.
Your heart could struggle to push blood that high.
Your head is in the clouds.
But your bones can't keep up.
Your weight grows much faster than your strength.
The tallest man ever was real.
He needed leg braces just to walk.
In nineteen forty, a brace rubbed a small blister.
Would you still want to grow?
